0a0cbd67-23fa-4a3d-a8dc-06e3caa3ab2f.thesis: Agents can improve their own setup if every conversation is centralized with its tool calls and outputs, graded by LLM-as-judge scorers against team rubrics, and the failures are periodically handed to a self-improvement agent that proposes skill changes whose effect shows up in tracked scores.

11b98f47-dcc2-4524-8c06-d1f6c3ff044b.thesis: Because agents now open most pull requests and few teams review every line, a software factory can only move toward autonomy if every loop carries independent, layered automated verification (deterministic analysis, agentic review, supply-chain checks) plus agent-generated evidence that the work is correct.

18628ea8-d66a-4d7b-adbd-730d3a43d92e.thesis: In welcoming the final keynote block, Ksenia Se observes that hiring is a main reason people attend and suggests attendees build an agent to rank speakers' companies and match their open roles, then talk to those people in person rather than auto-sending resumes.

1cbc625f-7f07-49bb-9c5c-57c95f07ba77.thesis: Troyanovsky argues that agents diffuse into real firms only when they are simple and reliable, which comes from encoding opinionated processes as behavior specs and supervising whether trajectories follow them, not just from outcome-based evals.

29083884-87dc-44f8-b412-b494afca8856.thesis: Katz argues that models have absorbed the harness tricks that once added coding intelligence, but the harness is not dead: it opens each new frontier of tasks for the data flywheel and owns infrastructure, trust and efficiency that the model cannot absorb.

44e9d04a-e8b4-418c-8a85-02fbb9263dd0.thesis: At Apollo's structured-credit arm, AI becomes mission-critical only when it runs on the firm's own reconciled data with a validated golden source, which requires the vendor to sit with the teams and learn their workflows.

4add802c-6a68-4e9c-93fb-9c1e017193bc.thesis: Shaukat argues that agentic software factories, like Toyota's factories, must engineer confidence through clear intent, guide rails, independent verification and evidence, because human review, LLM judges and long agent runs cannot keep up with abundant AI-generated code.

4b33ac12-ed84-4e32-be63-6a4f9f3acb32.thesis: As implementation gets cheap and agents run longer unattended, the failure mode becomes product incoherence, so teams must carry intent, prior decisions, and ownership context from intake through implementation and review and distill human judgment back into the agents' context.

68a1e78b-569e-4314-a56f-f20508123cbe.thesis: Because frontier models now outpace adoption, financial firms should stop hand-building agents one by one and build a reusable five-layer foundation (MCP connectors, skills, identity and permissions, human approval, evals) that lets them scale agents safely.

6b92fb75-064e-4cb5-8aa3-7c7f211e7420.thesis: GEICO's coding agents sped up the inner loop but major legacy modernization stayed bottlenecked on collaboration and context, so it built a multiplayer AI-native war room, steered by a Markdown fleet manager, that maps a legacy domain and ships an agent-callable API in a day.

736edd83-bb08-49f1-90ed-722b7ed07eb2.thesis: AI writing slop does not go away as models scale, so Towards AI built a voice-matching creative-writing benchmark with multiple drafts and cross-family LLM judges, and found the practical goal is the model least annoying to edit, not a perfect one-shot.

73badd10-6f8c-4c95-b5e7-55fc3d7bafc1.thesis: Two Sigma gives agents real autonomy safely by composing lightweight controls — an agent registry, risk-tiered review, declared tool entitlements enforced at runtime, shared evals, and classifier-gated approvals — instead of locking everything down or relying on policy documents.

871cd5c8-13f4-4fe9-ac49-c8b25d970add.thesis: Because frontier models are commoditizing, labs must recoup trillion-dollar bets by locking businesses in at the agent layer or competing with them directly, so companies should build their agentic systems on open foundations like Hermes Agent that they own and control.

8d348b6c-25cc-45de-8dc4-aaa3d7130918.thesis: Despite a flood of agent payment protocols, agents barely pay because friction at every stage of the funnel (need, setup, discovery and trust, pay-per-use billing) suppresses demand, and that friction is only now starting to clear.

8d424512-c7f0-483c-9094-ca899d7bb1fd.thesis: Agent frameworks that agree on almost nothing all converge on running code in a separate sandboxed computer, so builders should commit to that execution boundary first and treat the framework as a swappable choice.

9a9dfcd0-459f-43eb-b3f8-004864b4ad2a.thesis: A hedge fund can be engineered as a function from external and internal context to a stock/size/timing decision, decomposed into steps whose runners (code, statistics, LLMs, people) and settings are tuned like hyperparameters against an evaluable north star.

a84ca3a8-cc2f-4b50-a635-fc380f6f04f6.thesis: Bridgewater argues that AI only becomes useful for investing when it sits on a governed, ontology-aligned corpus of internal and external unstructured data, served to both humans and agents and wired into investors' existing habits so their work compounds.

af8422e8-d5f8-4dbd-a918-6360f5bfba80.thesis: Valenzuela argues that scaling next-frame video prediction turns video models into real-time, interactive world simulators that learn physics on their own and could eventually render any interface, operating system, or agent's visual reasoning.

b2ed4456-5671-4e8e-83fd-684c012fef8c.thesis: The AI engineer's job has moved from writing features to building the always-on loop (traces, evals, agents reading telemetry, fixes) that improves the product, with evaluator alignment to human judgment as the core skill.

b8bb725d-daf0-4ac0-8095-5737841c89e5.thesis: Agents are now the main web searchers, and Exa Snapshot's dated versions of the web let teams backtest search-driven financial models and agents without future information leaking in, while checking that features generalize.

bdab432a-0538-4431-ad5a-62653affd9da.thesis: A naive prompt-a-model-on-the-diff review agent misses bugs, lacks context, costs too much and nitpicks, so a good one needs historical-bug evals, a different model than the author, a living codebase wiki, sandboxed end-to-end testing and per-subtask model selection.

c34c075b-c695-4227-bf8e-3b4eeb3460d9.thesis: Enterprise AI faces a steep diffusion gap: nearly all large firms have rolled out a general-purpose LLM, but agents in non-engineering work remain at about five percent.

c4ba0138-6f6d-4780-93a1-4d8f0c478339.thesis: When an enterprise agent task has no benchmark and little expert access, start from a known answer (a source page, a rule, a template clause) and generate the input around it, so evaluation becomes automatic and iteration speeds up.

c901e963-5be9-4a1d-86a3-d9354374bbcd.thesis: Cutting an AI bill starts with measuring token spend per team and use case, then right-sizing models and tokens-per-second to each workload, buying capacity against the base load, and judging tokens by outcomes rather than usage.

cada670e-c5ea-4977-b3c2-9a68dda26abb.thesis: General Intuition bets that scaling action-labeled gameplay video from Medal into pixels-in, actions-out models will produce general agents that act in real time across games, computers and robots, the way scaling code produced coding agents.

caecd5f6-b352-4868-a995-f0f71679caf0.thesis: Even though frontier models keep getting cheaper and better, Ramp argues it pays to do applied research now (specialist post-trained models, KV-cache cartridges, agent swarms) to cut latency and token cost rather than waiting for the labs.

dd25c0a8-d64f-4d6e-a597-7dd576eabc16.thesis: The day-one close recaps the final keynotes and urges attendees to use the talks as a starting point for conversations with each other.

edb4f982-0cb8-48ee-8bf7-410255a40cb3.thesis: Agents can only be trusted to finish work without humans reading every line when each task carries a deterministic, app-specific verification loop that proves the outcome with evidence and feeds failures back to the agent.

ee927042-2ba1-44c3-b304-d001ae247839.thesis: Trusting agents in regulated workflows starts by treating written policy as the institution's original intent, separating it from the constantly changing running system, and placing agents inside gated workflow graphs that keep required checks.

f7204e6d-a47c-4535-804e-16b4db579b95.thesis: Carson argues that engineers should stop coding locally and instead manage fleets of cloud agent sessions, with builder, reviewer, QA, manager and merge agents escalating to a human who must personally verify feature videos, and should hire for agent-operating skill.

fca86857-d079-46a6-94a7-62b0bb8e5d31.thesis: Teams serving open models with vLLM mostly guess at configuration, so a live benchmarking harness (Runpod's Benchpod) that lets them change knobs quickly and measure TTFT, inter-token latency and throughput under realistic concurrency is how to get from R&D to production.
